result.instructions: Tools for Keyword.com, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How did my keyword rankings move this week?"; "Which of my tracked keywords lost the most positions in the last 30 days?"; "What is our share of voice against our competitors?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Keyword.com data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run keyword_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run keyword_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run keyword_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. keyword_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: keyword_get_current_user
tools.title: Get the current user
tools.description: Return the profile and subscription details of the account that owns the API token. Good first call to confirm the connection. Keyword.com API: GET /api/v2/users/self.

include.description: Optional related resources to include, as the API accepts them.

tools.name: keyword_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List the active projects and groups (subprojects) on the account with their tags and keyword counts. Groups have [sub] in their name. Keyword.com API: GET /api/v2/groups/active.

tools.name: keyword_get_project
tools.title: Get a project
tools.description: Get one project or group with its keyword counts, last ranking update and sharing identifiers. Keyword.com API: GET /api/v2/groups/{project_name}.

project_name.description: Project name, or group name with the [sub] convention, e.g. Disney[sub]Disney Classics (from keyword_list_projects).

tools.name: keyword_list_keywords
tools.title: List keywords
tools.description: List one page of keywords in a project or group (default 20 per page; use page and per_page for more) with current Google rank, best rank, search volume, CPC and URL tracked. Keyword.com API: GET /api/v2/groups/{project_name}/keywords.

project_name.description: Project name, or group name with the [sub] convention, e.g. Disney[sub]Disney Classics (from keyword_list_projects).

tools.name: keyword_get_keyword
tools.title: Get a keyword
tools.description: Get one keyword with its current and best rank, movement, search metrics and SERP features. Keyword.com API: GET /api/v2/groups/{project_name}/keywords/{keyword_id}.

project_name.description: Project name, or group name with the [sub] convention, e.g. Disney[sub]Disney Classics (from keyword_list_projects).

tools.name: keyword_get_rank_history
tools.title: Get rank history
tools.description: Return the daily ranking position of each keyword for the given number of days before today. One call covers at most 400,000 keyword-days (each keyword counts days + 1). Keyword.com API: POST /api/v2/keywords/chart?action=bulkChart.

days.description: Days of history (default 30). The keyword-day cap applies.

tools.name: keyword_get_keyword_metrics
tools.title: Get keyword metrics
tools.description: Get keyword movement metrics (counts of keywords up, down and new) for a project, group or tag over a timeframe. Keyword.com API: GET /api/v2/groups/{project_name}/metrics.

project_name.description: Project name, or group name with the [sub] convention, e.g. Disney[sub]Disney Classics (from keyword_list_projects).

tagId.description: Tag id to filter by (from keyword_get_project tags).

timeframe.description: Timeframe value, as the Keyword.com API accepts it.

tools.name: keyword_get_competitors
tools.title: Get competitors for a keyword
tools.description: Return the top 100 competing URLs for one keyword over a date range, with their rank position and result type. Keyword.com API: GET /api/v2/metrics/{project_name}/competitors/{keyword_id}/history.

project_name.description: Project name, or group name with the [sub] convention, e.g. Disney[sub]Disney Classics (from keyword_list_projects).

dateRange.description: Date range value, as the Keyword.com API accepts it.

tools.name: keyword_list_regions
tools.title: List tracked regions
tools.description: List the Google regions tracked in a project or group. Keyword.com API: GET /api/v2/groups/{project_name}/regions.

project_name.description: Project name, or group name with the [sub] convention, e.g. Disney[sub]Disney Classics (from keyword_list_projects).

tools.name: keyword_get_top_pages
tools.title: Get top pages
tools.description: Return the top-performing pages of a project or group, ranked by their keyword positions. Keyword.com API: GET /api/v2/groups/{project_name}/keywords/ranking-urls.

project_name.description: Project name, or group name with the [sub] convention, e.g. Disney[sub]Disney Classics (from keyword_list_projects).

tools.name: keyword_get_share_of_voice_history
tools.title: Get share of voice history
tools.description: Return share of voice over a date range or a fixed number of days, for a project. Keyword.com API: GET /api/v2/projects/{project_id}/mindshare/from-cache.

project_id.description: Project id (numeric id of the project or group).

tools.name: keyword_add_keywords
tools.title: Add keywords to a project
tools.description: Add keywords to a project or group for rank tracking. Adds to the plan's keyword count; a keyword the project already tracks gets its settings updated, not duplicated. A new keyword gets a ranking update at once. Keyword.com API: POST /api/v2/groups/{project_name}/keywords.

project_name.description: Project name, or group name with the [sub] convention, e.g. Disney[sub]Disney Classics (from keyword_list_projects).

region.description: Google region, e.g. google.com or google.co.uk.

language.description: Language code, e.g. en, fr, de.

url.description: Domain to track. Without a trailing / tracks the domain; with / tracks the exact URL.

prompts.name: read_the_rank_history_of_keywords
prompts.title: Read the rank history of keywords

prompts.name: see_who_ranks_for_a_keyword

prompts.description: Read the top 100 competing URLs for one keyword over a date range, with their rank and result type.

prompts.name: check_share_of_voice_and_top_pages
prompts.title: Check share of voice and top pages
prompts.description: Read share of voice over a date range or a number of days. Read the top-performing pages of a project by their keyword positions.

prompts.description: Check the tracked regions of a project, then add keywords for rank tracking. A keyword the project already tracks gets its settings updated, not duplicated.
